description.p: Vitreus opens a photo over your dimmed desktop with the rest of the folder in a film strip underneath. Hold an arrow key to fly through hundreds of photos; click outside or press Esc and it's gone. No library, no import, no account: just a viewer, in the spirit of Picasa Photo Viewer.
It opens JPEG, HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, camera RAW (CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF and more), Photoshop PSD, PNG, animated GIF and WebP, TIFF, SVG and more.
